alpha.selection_rationale: Coherent 1.5g strike fleet: two torpedo cruisers deliver saturation alpha strikes (192 rounds between them) while the battlecruiser pair provides a spinal-coiler gun line to punish anything that survives or tries to kite; corvettes screen ahead and add cheap torpedo waves. Uniform fleet speed keeps the torpedo geometry favorable - we close on our terms, saturate, and the guns finish.
alpha.formation_rationale: Lancer battlecruisers form the forward gun line at +100km, absorbing the first exchange; Darts ride ahead and wide at +130km with lateral/vertical offset to spread enemy spinal fire and screen the center. Harpoon torpedo cruisers hang back at -110km, well outside gun range, where they can launch torpedoes while the vanguard covers them; the 80km separation between the Harpoons keeps them tight enough for overlapping PD while their lateral offset complicates enemy targeting solutions.

beta.selection_rationale: An eight-ship, all-1.5g fast-capital line that spends all 200 points: two heavily armored cruisers anchor the formation while six battlecruisers provide concentrated spinal-and-turret fire. The uniform speed preserves coordinated kiting or a synchronized close-range gun pass against unknown opposition.
beta.formation_rationale: The Bastions form a forward, mutually supporting vanguard to absorb the first exchange. Lancers are staggered in lateral and vertical pairs behind them, preserving overlapping PD within roughly 100 km while spreading the fleet enough to complicate enemy spinal targeting; the rear pair serves as a reserve and flanking element.
